notes: Both prepositional predicates take their whole *shall be* frame under rules 20 and 49, headed on the preposition; the middle colon gaps the copula and its בְּ keeps only *at*.

*the king's house* is a possessive recasting, so its single *the* determines the possessor (rule 29), while *the gate of the foundation* is arthrous and each noun takes the *the* standing before its own word; *the courts of the house of Jehovah* writes no article morpheme at all, so both *the*s are supplied under rule 29's multi-level allowance.
